a single notification for all matching episodes.

#/components/schemas/Kibana_HTTP_APIs_al.description: The grouping mode: per_episode groups by episode lifecycle, all sends a single notification for all alerts, per_field groups by the specified fields.

per_page.description: The number of action policies per page.

total.description: The total number of action policies matching the query.

created_by_user.description: Whether this policy was created by a user (vs system-generated).

owner.description: The owner of the action policy.

created_at.description: The ISO datetime when the action policy was created.

created_by.description: The user ID who created the action policy.

description.description: A description of the action policy.

enabled.description: Whether the action policy is enabled.

group_by.description: The fields used to group alerts, or null for no grouping.

grouping_mode.description: The grouping mode for alert notifications.

id.description: The unique identifier for the action policy.

matcher.description:
Selects the alerts this policy applies to. Set `tags` to match alerts from rules with those tags. Set `expression` to a KQL query, which will be evaluated against each alert.

If you set both `tags` and `expression`, an alert must match the tags and the expression for the policy to apply. When `matcher` is `null`, or when both `tags` and `expression` are empty, the policy applies to all alerts.

expression.description: A KQL query that's evaluated against each alert. Supported fields are: `episode_id`, `episode_status`, `group_hash`, `last_event_timestamp`, `severity`, `rule.id`, `rule.name`, `rule.tags`, and your rule's query output columns under `data.*` (for example, `data.host.name`). Referencing other fields won't work. Omit `matcher.expression` or set it to `null` to match on `tags` alone.

tags.description: Rule tags this policy should match. The policy applies to alerts from any rule that has at least one of these tags. `matcher.tags` is separate from the policy's own `tags` field, which is used to organize and filter action policies. Omit `matcher.tags` or set it to `null` to match on `matcher.expression` alone.

name.description: The name of the action policy.

snoozed_until.description: The ISO datetime until which the policy is snoozed, or null if not snoozed.

interval.description: The throttle interval duration (e.g. 5m, 1h), or null when the strategy is intervalless.

anyOf.description: notify only on episode status transitions (default for `per_episode`).
notify on transitions and at regular intervals.
notify at regular intervals regardless of status (default for `all`/`per_field`).
notify on every evaluation cycle (high volume).

updated_by.description: The user ID who last updated the action policy.

version.description: The version, used for optimistic concurrency control.
